('r6','before'):[(20,199,366,273),(40,336,232,352),(40,369,240,385)],
('r6','after'):[(145,229,359,287)]
}

 im=Image.open(path).convert('RGB')
 d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
 for box in masks.get((key,side),[]):

 return im

for key,title,name,afterdir,change in rows:
 bp=src/'before'/f'{name}.png'; ap=src/afterdir/f'{name}.png'
 b=safe_image(bp,key,'before'); a=safe_image(ap,key,'after')
 b.save(out/'screens'/f'{key}-before.png'); a.save(out/'screens'/f'{key}-after.png')
 canvas=Image.new('RGB',(832,948),'#F3EBDD'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
 d.text((20,14),f'{key.upper()}  {title}',font=font(24),fill='#58452F')

 canvas.paste(b,(20,84));canvas.paste(a,(422,84))
 canvas.save(out/f'{key}-before-after.png')
 manifest.append({'id':key,'title':title,'category':'REDESIGN' if key[0]=='r' else 'POLISH','change':change,'before':str(bp.relative_to(root)),'after':str(ap.relative_to(root)),'masks':{side:masks.get((key,side),[]) for side in ['before','after']}})
bases=[('b1','厨房','final-runtime/01-kitchen.png'),('b2','农场','after/35-farm.png'),('b3','生意','keep-business-family/01-business.png'),('b4','寻访','keep-journey-precision-states/01-world.png')]
basecanvas=Image.new('RGB',(1640,914),'#F3EBDD'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(basecanvas)
for i,(key,title,path) in enumerate(bases):
 im=Image.open(src/path).convert('RGB'); im.save(out/'screens'/f'{key}-after.png')
 d.text((20+i*406,15),title,font=font(25),fill='#58452F');basecanvas.paste(im,(20+i*406,55))
 manifest.append({'id':key,'title':title,'category':'BASELINE','after':str((src/path).relative_to(root))})
basecanvas.save(out/'runtime-style-baselines.png')
# Final runtime only: four style anchors, then redesigns and polish pages.
items=[(key,title) for key,title,_ in bases]+[(key,title) for key,title,*_ in rows]
w,h=210,498
sheet=Image.new('RGB',(w*4+32,h*5+82),'#F3EBDD');d=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
d.text((20,14),'UI REMASTER · 最终 Runtime 总览',font=font(25),fill='#58452F')
d.text((20,49),'收藏画面仅使用旧内容、未辨认状态或文字遮罩',font=font(15),fill='#786C59')
for i,(key,title) in enumerate(items):
 x=20+(i%4)*w;y=86+(i//4)*h
 d.text((x,y),f'{key.upper()} {title}',font=font(15),fill='#58452F')
 im=Image.open(out/'screens'/f'{key}-after.png');im.thumbnail((195,422),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS);sheet.paste(im,(x,y+30))
sheet.save(out/'contact-sheet.png')
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
assert initial==codehash(),'Unexpected source change'
print(json.dumps({'pairs':len(rows),'redesign':6,'polish':10,'style_screens':4,'contact_tiles':len(items),'source_unchanged_during_assembly':True,'output':str(out)},ensure_ascii=False))
'@ | python -"

厨房与农场都需要重新组织主场景，不是只移动两个按钮。厨房的调味料和清洁入口应在 HUD 下方同一顶线，操作台成为中部主视觉，仓库／手艺／商店用场景物件承载，厨具架固定在操作台下方。农场需要将主要功能纳入首屏院落、提高旧伙伴的可读尺寸与接地阴影；不是新增作物或模拟玩法。
